description: A page of a list's items. Data is left out unless includeData (or path) is set. filters use the list's filtering indexes (get_list shows them), by pathName: string indexes match partially, number indexes take lt:, lte:, gt:, gte: (e.g. "gte:10"), date indexes take before: and after: (e.g. "before:2026-01-01"). order takes createdAt, updatedAt, alias, readonly, activated, or a sorting index's pathName. An index that is still building fails with INDEX_BUILDING. 1 request, plus 1 the first time a list's data is read in a session, to find its guard indexes (unless get_list was called).

alias.description: Only items whose alias value contains this

filters.description: Filter values by filtering index pathName, e.g. { "score": "gte:100", "due": "before:2026-01-01" }

identityId.description: Only items owned by this identity

includeGuarded.description: Only when this server acts as an identity: include guarded values in the items that identity owns

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

order.description: createdAt, updatedAt, alias, readonly, activated, or a sorting index's pathName

path.description: A JSONPath (e.g. $.name) selecting part of each item's data; implies includeData

tagged.description: Only those with these tags: every element must match (AND), and an element can list alternatives separated by commas (OR), e.g. ["game", "draft,review"]

name: list_items
title: List a list's items
